events.description: A collision on road_0044, the narrow connector between loc_0028 and loc_0022, blocks a route that lies very close to the direct start‑goal axis, forcing traffic to detour significantly.
Roadworks on road_0031 (loc_0021–loc_0057) and road_0033 (loc_0021–loc_0022) shut down the low‑degree junction at loc_0021, cutting off two parallel approaches that are key to reaching the goal area.

Light roadworks slow traffic on road_0057 (loc_0038–loc_0077) and road_0124 (loc_0077–loc_0080) by a factor of 2.5; these corridors are the main links from the side region to the goal, so congestion will spread to nearby routes.
